searchText: Core devs would decide to adjust the TTD in the same way the original was set. Node operators then decide if they’re going to follow that change or not as is the usual process for hard forks. There is no guarantee that a different TTD would be lower. There’s no other chain that can support this level of hash rate profitably so it’s expected they’ll generally keep mining up until the terminal block because it will be the most profitable thing to do (even without ETH price rising). But it’s impossible to know for sure which is one reason we may need to adjust the TTD. Just observing the price action (and the gas fees around that), my gut tells me hashrate may be more likely to go up rather than down as we approach the merge. If narrative-based momentum maintains. More likely it goes up than down I agree. I think almost all 5G devices are off now. That being said I haven’t seen 100 badly informed people panicking in the inno telegram yet due to their a10 they haven’t touched in years stopping so maybe not. core devs call discussed that there was some trick to run 5G devices still but I think it was just a rumor (?) For gpus there’s zombie mode past the 5G dag (which is reached in late august) But most 5G devices are ASICS (I think) That being said I now suddenly recall one person saying a few days ago the 720mhs 5G model is actually 5.1 or sometbing cause it works fine so maybe those ASICS are still going <@97774605351010304>Sir, I can use ropsten in exchange for goerli. Can I Does anyone know who the owner is for https://notes.ethereum.org/@launchpad/merge-configuration-checklist ? I think we should add `Check the flag for fee recipient...` (Don't leave that empty!). I know we all love burned eth but still 😄
